`interface IGlMipmapBuilder`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`BlitGlMipmapBuilder`](/reference/base-opengl/blitglmipmapbuilder/), [`DrawGlMipmapBuilder`](/reference/base-opengl/drawglmipmapbuilder/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.texture` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [IGlMipmapBuilder.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/texture/IGlMipmapBuilder.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

Builds the mipmap levels of a texture of OpenGL from its first level.

## Description

[`GlRenderBridge`](/reference/base-opengl/glrenderbridge/) uses a [`BlitGlMipmapBuilder`](/reference/base-opengl/blitglmipmapbuilder/) when the context can blit framebuffers, a [`DrawGlMipmapBuilder`](/reference/base-opengl/drawglmipmapbuilder/) otherwise.
